summary: Frontend-only regression for 4 targeted changes on Gold Skin Spa site. All 4 changes verified working: (1) Section order now Services→LeadCapture→Gallery→GiftCards→Contact→FAQ→Footer as expected. (2) FAQ section has ivory bg rgb(241,233,218) with dark ink text; toggles expand/collapse correctly. (3) Navbar Book Now visible on desktop (1440) with ivory bg + dark text, and correctly hidden on mobile (500) — not in navbar nor in the hamburger menu. (4) Gift Cards redesigned to a 2-col layout: preview on left, configurator on right; only inputs are amount presets, custom amount, design select, recipient toggle, and checkout — NO recipient name/email/sender/date/message fields present. Interactions verified: preset $500 updates preview to $500, design select Onyx updates preview to 'Onyx Noir', recipient 'Myself' toggle highlights with gold bg, checkout button shows success toast '$500 · Onyx Noir gift card — checkout is coming soon.'. Regression: contact submit toast, lead-capture empty-error and valid-success toasts all working. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: GiftCards.jsx: `min='0'` on custom amount input allows 0 which then triggers the error toast on checkout — acceptable but slightly redundant with client validation; consider min='1'.
Navbar: no keyboard-visible focus ring on mobile menu items (a11y minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_3 verified all 4 changes pass. Gift Cards has 2-col configurator with preview tilt on hover. FAQ ivory bg confirmed. Book Now correctly hidden below lg breakpoint and NOT duplicated in the mobile hamburger menu.
